title: NasheyOptimized
description: It optimized and give stable performance with lower end system
body:
**NasheyOptimized**

**NasheyOptimized** is a lightweight performance-focused modpack designed to significantly boost FPS and improve overall smoothness in **Minecraft**. This modpack focuses purely on optimization, helping players run Minecraft smoothly even on low-end hardware.

The pack includes powerful performance mods such as **Sodium** and **Cactus**, which improve rendering performance, reduce lag, and make gameplay much smoother compared to vanilla Minecraft.

**Performance Tested:**
NasheyOptimized was tested on a laptop with an **Intel i5-6200U processor and Intel HD 520 graphics**, where it showed a noticeable FPS boost and more stable frame rates compared to vanilla gameplay.

**Features**

* Significant FPS boost using **Sodium**
* Additional optimization improvements from **Cactus**
* Faster rendering and smoother chunk loading
* Lightweight and stable
* Designed for low-end and mid-range PCs
* No unnecessary mods — focused purely on performance

**Installation**
This modpack is **only available on Modrinth**.

**Created by:** *NasheyYT / NasheyIsThere* 🚀

Note: This modpack is made by **NasheyYT** and it helps to optimize your game to give it a super smooth experience on lower end hardware or old laptops or PC's i currently tested on **I5 6200U** cpu and **HD 520** graphics it reach about 100+ fps i recommend to set it to 60 max fps to give it a super stable performance
